modalities.value: audio and text inputs; textual outputs

source.quote:
designed to process both audio and
                                           text inputs to generate textual outputs
The total parameters of Qwen2-Audio is 8.2B parameters.

architecture.value: Audio encoder initialized from Whisper-large-v3 plus Qwen-7B LLM; three-stage training (pre-training, SFT, DPO)

source.quote:
initialization of the audio encoder of Qwen2-Audio is based on the Whisper-
large-v3 model (Radford et al., 2023).

trainingData.value: Natural language prompts for different data and tasks; further expanded data volume; SFT and DPO preference triplets

source.quote: utilized natural language prompts for different data and tasks and have further expanded the data volume.

findings.text: The report has no dedicated safety, red-teaming, jailbreak, bias, toxicity, privacy, or dangerous-capability section or numeric safety evals.

source.quote:
we still perform a comprehensive evaluation that encompasses various tasks, namely Automatic Speech
Recognition (ASR), Speech-to-Text Translation (S2TT), Speech Emotion Recognition (SER), Vocal Sound
Classification (VSC).

findings.text: The abstract claims direct preference optimization (DPO) improved factuality and adherence to desired behavior, without reporting a factuality or honesty metric.

source.quote: DPO has optimized the model’s performance in terms of factuality and adherence

findings.text: During AIR-Bench chat testing, Gemini-1.5 could not return some samples for SAFETY reasons, so its sample count was cut by about one fifth.

source.quote: correctly return some test samples due to its SAFETY reasons during testing

findings.text: Qwen2-Audio is described as open-sourced; no license string is given in the paper.

source.quote:
Qwen2-Audio is open-sourced with the aim of fostering
                                                           the advancement of the multi-modal language community.

notes: Technical report (arXiv 2407.10759), not a system card. No safety/alignment eval tables. Skipped all capability numbers (ASR WER, S2TT BLEU, SER/VSC ACC, AIR-Bench GPT-4 chat scores in Table 2 and Figure 1). Figure 3 pre-training hours chart has no readable numbers in the text layer. Report names only 'Qwen2-Audio' (8.2B, Qwen-7B backbone); mapped to seed Qwen/Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct as the post-SFT/DPO chat model described. Checkpoint Qwen/Qwen2-Audio-7B is not named. Abstract DPO factuality claim left as a finding only (no honesty/hallucination topic coverage).
